verdicts.reason: A: the glow circle has slid off the product and now sits behind the text column, so the can floats on bare background. The NEW/LIMITED RUN pills are stacked top right, larger than the logo and crowding it, and the logo is off-axis. 'Swipe up to shop' is oversized and placed above the CTA. The bottom third is dead space. B: the order and hierarchy are clearer (product, then a full-width headline, then the CTA), but the badges are oversized and NEW butts into LIMITED RUN at the top left, outweighing the logo. The glow circle is offset right, away from the small product. The body copy leaves an orphan line ('summer evenings.'). 'Swipe up to shop' is too large and sits above the button.
